body.statement: The extended Wasserstein loss used by GANICE is exactly the conditioning-marginal average of ordinary outcome-space \(W_1\) distances between the two conditional laws at the same state.

source.locator: Definition 1 and the statewise identity immediately after equation (1), arXiv:2605.10206v1, Section 3.1
source.verbatim_statement: Thus, \(\mathrm{eW}_{1}\) is exactly the conditioning-marginal average of ordinary outcome-space Wasserstein distances.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Tamano and Imaizumi, arXiv:2605.10206v1, Section 3.1, immediately after Definition 1 and equation (1).
